r: For the NVMe device given, and the endurance group identifier specified, list the possible configurations for Flexible Data Placement.

-e <NUM>, --endgrp-id=<NUM>
The endurance group identifier to use when requesting the log page.
-H, --human-readable
Parse, print and describe individual parts of bitfields.
-b, --raw-binary
Print the raw buffer to the standard output stream.
-o <fmt>, --output-format=<fmt>
Set the reporting format to normal, json, or binary. Only one output format can be used at a time.
